Large-scale benchmark of MC-PDFT/NEVPT2 over the 542 vertical excitations of QUESTDB using the APC ranked-orbital automated active-space selection scheme. No row is extractable: the main text reports only aggregate statistics (mean absolute errors by active space and basis: SA-CASSCF ~0.39 +/- 0.03 eV once poor spaces are filtered), never a specific compound paired with a specific active space - the per-molecule APC-generated spaces live in the SI data files. Protocol worth remembering even though it yields no row: candidate orbitals are the up to 23 highest doubly occupied and 23 lowest virtual HF orbitals, symmetry-grouped and Boys-localized, ranked by approximated orbital entropies from diagonal Fock and exchange matrix elements, then pruned lowest-entropy-first until the CSF count hits a cap; singly occupied orbitals get the maximum entropy. Uniform sizes (12,12), (10,10), (8,8) were applied across the whole database, and a 1.1 eV SA-CASSCF error threshold was used post hoc to discard the 20-40 percent of automatically chosen spaces that were poor.
